confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on scattered, partly dated (some 2023) aggregator and venue-level snippets that use inconsistent ARS-to-USD rates; the beer and coffee figures cluster around USD 3.5 to 5 across sources, and the meal figures vary widely. Argentine prices move fast with inflation and the peso, so July 2026 levels are uncertain. Cocktail and wine_glass are weakly sourced: the wine figures come from one undated review and one undated menu, so cocktail was set relative to beer (roughly 1.7 times) and wine_glass from the house-wine glass prices seen in those sources, adjusted for restaurant markup. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, not from inspected live listings or current prices, and carry the widest uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized Argentine tourist city with a wine-region premium, benchmarked against other mid-sized Latin American cities with similar tourism demand and a volatile currency. Beer and coffee follow the cluster of 2026 aggregator figures; restaurant anchors follow a discount to Buenos Aires-style tourist pricing; accommodation follows general knowledge of Mendoza's hostel and hotel tiers.
